We are approaching Eljune. You can see the Bloody Outpost in the distance, a place where epic battles took place. Let us honor the memory of the heroes who died fighting for it!

As for Eljune, this place is famous for its ancient history. It's where one of the main June cities, June Itsmal, was located. We uncovered its true secrets fairly recently, thanks to the talented researcher from the Empire – Marianna Lopatina.

According to the scholar Sarang Kharkhebi, Marianna's main accomplishment was not unveiling the obvious, but showing the mundane: the life of common peasants and laborers of that ancient epoch!
customData/elements/Item/text

Look to your right. This is Tensess Temple. The greatest structure of the Zem people, it used to be one of Tep's Pyramids where this crazy Summoner spent thousands of years dying and then resurrecting.

We know that Tensess' Soul managed to banish Tep from the Pyramid, which created the Magic of Light. However, its true meaning was only revealed when Tensess' sacrifice was followed by Nezeb's and Skrakan's sacrifice. The League denied the obvious for a long time, but the unchallengeable truth of these facts forced them to acknowledge the authority of the Trinity Church!

On the right, you can see the abandoned Zem Ruins and archeological digs. A bit of history: the Zem civilization was situated in the Aether river valley. Originally, Zem tribes lived in small towns, and each had its own ruler, Negus or Nomarkh. Later these towns were united into the state of Hickut governed by Despots.

Before Tep's ascension, there was a rebellion in Hickut that put an end to the reign of Despots. A handful of their supporters fled the state. They are now known as Zem Heretics.
customData/elements/Item/text

Good afternoon, friends! Allow me to welcome you to the Holy Land. We are flying over the Coba Plateau. I'm certain you can appreciate the view. It looks so much like our homeland!

However, one must remember that nefarious arms dealers operated here. They collected Artifacts of Darkness.

This is where the tragic battle between Zem mechanics and Tep took place. Everyone died. Perhaps they will build a memorial here.

We are approaching the Coba Plateau. A scorched desert filled with ancient knowledge hidden deep underground... They say lots of miracles happened here. The chief one being the creation of the Holy Weapons... which then turned into the Artifacts of Darkness.

It was the mage Gorluxor and his demon cultists who desecrated the Holy Sites where the Power of the Light found its way into our world!

These days the place is scavenged by artifact hunters known as the Prospectors... They cleanse them and turn them back into the Sources of Light... But there are also people who use them for malicious purposes. The worst kind is the mysterious tavern owner. Some people see him, others don't.
customData/elements/Item/text

It's quite a strange land full of ruins that remember the battles of the past... The problem is the scavengers... Goblins, the so-called Arms Mafia... As the League and the Empire started to lose their power, the Goblins' ambitions soared... They want to control everything that's against the law – piracy, smuggling, and all kinds of illicit trade. They got into Umoir while our ruler was busy with something else. They poach and sell animals. But we'll find a way to deal with them!

This is where our journey ends. Thank you for using our services.

We are leaving Eljune. The fortress in the distance is the Bloody Outpost. Many swords and shields were broken here. And the tents before the Outpost are the Eljune Bazaar, the Free Traders' camp.

You can say a lot about the Free Traders – that they only care about gold and will sell their mother for the right price. We must also mention the Tycoons – the seven wealthiest Traders. They are Ivan Chelezny, the ruler of Dane and its ports; Sigurd the Swindler, a meteorite ore miner; Hugh de Blizare, a newspaper and magazine owner; Profka the Fierce, the orc who is friendly with pirates; and a Zem whose name I don't know. They say he's the new owner of the Death Plant... There's also a Xadaganian among them – I hear she's involved in some unlawful dealings... and of course, the Master Goblin who has friends all over Sarnaut.

Dear friends! Look to your right, and you will see Tensess Temple. A mad Summoner called Tep was trapped in it, dying and resurrecting again for thousands of years! But Great Tensess banished him, and the place is now sacred.

They say Tensess left this world. And even his spirit is no longer in the Pyramid. But when he left, Tensess performed a new miracle – he predicted peace between the League and the Empire, and it has come to pass.

Of course, it will take years for the animosity to thaw, but this is where the first step took place!
